elevenlabsPrompt:
[intrigued] Your shopping apps know exactly which building you're standing in.

[confident] Here's the fix. Turn off Precise Location.

[friendly] Open Privacy and Security, then Location Services. Tap the app. Switch Precise Location off.

[delighted] The app still works. It just gets your neighborhood, not your front door.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
